g.text: Three features in a dry, windy area (not to scale)
Most sand moves near the ground
Centre: 15 cm lower than the earlier
A: a narrow stem below a wider top is a rock pedestal; abrasion
by sand moving near the ground wears the lower part most.
B: the centre has been lowered 15 cm while the rock margins
stayed put, so loose material was removed: a deflation hollow.
C: fine sediment has gone from between the stones and gravel now
covers 70% of the surface, not 40%: a desert pavement left by
selective removal. Stones are exposed and concentrated, not
